data.long_meaning: Xaverine is derived from the Latin name Xavier, which means 'new house'. In Christian tradition, it is associated with Saint Francis Xavier, a 16th-century missionary known for his dedication and service to others. The name Xaverine carries the meaning “New House” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Xaverine usually hope their child will grow to embody new house and live with faith, good character and purpose.
